the-abandoned-prototype.scenario: A prototype run that reached six of eleven checkpoints and was left there when the work moved elsewhere

the-one-session-chore.label: the-one-session-chore
the-one-session-chore.scenario: Shared CI and a 404 page added to a site template in a single session

the-fleet-backlog.label: the-fleet-backlog

the-fleet-round.label: the-fleet-round

the-second-feature.label: the-second-feature
the-second-feature.scenario: A second interactive feature on the same site, planned after the first one had taught the plan what to say

the-ci-cleanup.label: the-ci-cleanup
the-ci-cleanup.scenario: Continuous integration made honest across a set of related repos, the cheapest complete run in the corpus

the-third-feature.label: the-third-feature

the-accounting-run.label: the-accounting-run
the-accounting-run.scenario: The engine taught to account for itself - what it did, what it cost - and paused, not finished, at 25 of 32

the-demo.label: the-demo
the-demo.scenario: The engine demonstrating itself against a throwaway repo, six sessions, no model spend

the-rehearsal.label: the-rehearsal
the-rehearsal.scenario: A rehearsal of one engine feature end to end before it was let near real work
